title: Secrets into pods: AKS vs EKS vs GKE
summary: All three mount cloud secrets as files through the Secrets Store CSI driver and authenticate as the pod's own workload identity. Only the provider and the permission names differ.

dimensions.label: Installed as
values: CSI driver + ASCP (EKS add-on or Helm)

dimensions.label: Identity used
values: Pod's role via IRSA or Pod Identity

notes: The security property to look for: the cloud audit log shows the app's identity reading the secret, not a shared node or operator identity.
Syncing mounted secrets into Kubernetes Secrets is convenient but puts them back into etcd. Mount as files where you can.
